basics.name: Priyanka Chatterjee
basics.label: Backend Software Engineer · OAuth 2.0 / JWT Auth Systems · Go · Python · Node.js · AI-Assisted Development (Claude Code, Cursor) · 3.5+ Years

summaries.jumpcloud-auth-backend: Backend software engineer with 3.5+ years building secure, scalable microservices in Go, Python, and Node.js, with hands-on OAuth 2.0 and JWT-based authentication work and heavy day-to-day use of AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor) to accelerate delivery. Authored an LLM-driven Claude Code skill automating refactoring, test generation, and deployment for Turbot HQ, migrating 35+ modules to an event-driven architecture and cutting resource-discovery latency 70–90%.

work.name: Turbot HQ, Inc.
work.domainNote: Multi-cloud security, governance, and compliance software; makers of the open-source Steampipe / Powerpipe / Flowpipe / Tailpipe suite and the commercial Turbot Guardrails PSPM platform. Remote-first.
highlights: Designed and developed an internal REST API microservice in Go using the Gin framework as part of a greenfield build of Turbot Guardrails, a Preventive Security Posture Management (PSPM) SaaS product; secured endpoints with OAuth 2.0 authentication via Auth0, containerized with Docker, deployed to AWS EC2, and served as a gRPC client for several internal microservices.

Led the AWS SDK for JavaScript v2 to v3 migration across 180+ call sites and 11+ AWS services in production Node.js Lambdas, refactoring discovery, configuration-sync, tagging, and resource-cleanup workflows; reduced policy-code duplication ~60% via Nunjucks templating.

Authored an LLM-driven Claude Code skill automating code refactoring, unit test generation, deployment, and Terraform-driven integration testing to accelerate feature velocity; used it to migrate 35+ Azure cloud-governance modules from polling to push-based eventing via Azure Event Grid, cutting resource-discovery latency 70–90% and eliminating recurring API throttling.

Built a Kafka-based, fire-and-forget event-driven pipeline for Turbot Guardrails, where consumers asynchronously processed policy-enforcement events and fired a webhook once a policy was enforced; added a dead-letter queue (DLQ) to capture recurring failures for investigation.

Optimized complex PostgreSQL queries powering customer compliance audits — rewriting AWS IAM policy-evaluation queries with jsonb array elements and multi-stage CTEs — improving query performance 40% and eliminating a class of false-positive findings.
Resolved a production incident by diagnosing a Go service stuck in a Kubernetes CrashLoopBackOff, collaborating with the platform team to restore service.
